record.dic_text:
0224 'Uwriym {u:-ri:m'}

0217 的複數型; 陽性名詞

欽定本 - Urim 7; 7

烏陵 = "眾光"
1) 一些石頭, 放在大祭司胸牌的小袋裡, 當有某難題與爭論時, 用來求告上帝作出判決
record.edic_text:
0224 'Uwriym {oo-reem'}

plural of 0217;; n m

AV - Urim 7; 7

Urim = "lights"
1) stones kept in a pouch on the high-priest's breastplate, used
   in determining God's decision in certain questions and issues
